description: Opens a personal data breach in the Hermetics space of the organization, with its code and the end of the 72-hour period to notify the supervisory authority (art. 33(1)), counted from when the company became aware of it. Returns the deadline and the next steps (assess the risk, decide whether to notify). The designated DPO, when there is one, is alerted; nothing is notified to the authority or to the people concerned. Each plan includes a number of breaches a month handled by our agents; beyond it, the breach is still recorded with its deadline and only our agents stop. Prepared from the facts given; the decision is the user's, or the designated DPO validates it when the organization has one.

data_categories.description: Categories of personal data concerned, e.g. "identity", "bank details".

description.description: What happened, the systems involved and the measures already taken; no personal data needed.

discovered_at.description: When the company became aware of the breach (ISO 8601 date and time with time zone): the 72-hour period runs from it.

ongoing.description: True if the breach is still ongoing.
